youtube_title: Why Is Milk ALWAYS at the Back of the Store? #Shorts
youtube_description:
They're Tricking You #1. You went in just for milk and came out with a full bag. Why is the dairy section always at the very back? Reason 1 is logistics: trucks unload at the back and the big cold room is right there. Reason 2: you walk past the whole store first. The industry calls it 'building the basket'. A US store chain's dairy buyer told NPR they want customers to get to the back and see the wide array of items. Experts are split, so the honest answer is both. The fix: make a list, go straight to the back, grab the milk and leave.
Source: NPR Planet Money (2014).
